items: The River Severn is the longest river in Great Britain, at about 220 miles.
The shore of the Dead Sea is the lowest point on land, more than 400 metres below sea level.
Canada has the longest coastline of any country.
Vatican City is the smallest country in the world, at about 0.44 square kilometres.
Lake Baikal in Siberia is the deepest lake in the world.
Mount Everest's summit is about 8,849 metres above sea level.
Africa has 54 countries recognised by the United Nations.
The Amazon rainforest spreads across parts of nine countries.
Iceland sits on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, where the North American and Eurasian plates are pulling apart.
Greenland is the world's largest island that isn't a continent.
Ben Nevis, the highest mountain in the UK, is 1,345 metres high.
